reason: The README presents this repository as a unified DeepSeek Harness plugin portal that catalogs installable plugins and provides a scaffold workflow for developing new plugins, so plugin-development is the primary category.

summaries.zh: 用于集中展示和安装 DeepSeek Harness 插件，并提供创建新插件的脚手架流程。
summaries.en: A unified portal for discovering and installing DeepSeek Harness plugins and scaffolding new plugin projects.

capabilities: Catalogs DeepSeek Harness plugins and provides CLI installation commands
Provides instructions for scaffolding new plugins
References weather retrieval, local PDF parsing, and plugin bundle workflows
